row.rowText: Proportion Of Females Aged 15 Years Who Received The Nationally Recommended Doses Of HPV Vaccine
row.footnote: Data are based on 15-year-old age cohort. School-based HPV vaccination programme began in April 2019.  The HPV vaccination coverage from 2014 to 2019 include cohorts who (1) were not within the target group for school-based vaccination or (2) had received vaccination after 15 years of age.
